reverse_crossing_scientific_finding.summary: Universal Atelier functions as an independent empty receiver with zero-row witness attestation, custodial human review ref gates, live cryptographic span verification, and reverse citation tracking. Reverse crossing from prospective receiver into historical reference corpora is inherently directional and subject to ontology projection gaps rather than claiming lossless isomorphism.
